source_authority: Published product documentation; not adopted project policy
span_convention: One-based inclusive lines; SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines joined by LF without a trailing LF. Every named span applies separately to both listed instances; operative span bytes were equal after full body reads. Version-prefixed external references are not included in these shared spans.

claims.statement: The documented functionality is in public preview.
The preview functionality can change.
The described capability reads application accessibility/visual context and performs input and navigation; this is capability context, not a universal enablement mandate.
Availability described here applies to local sessions on macOS and Windows.
The interactive status command reports enablement of the plugin, MCP server and associated skills.
The interactive enablement command saves the local preference.
The enablement command activates the bundled computer-use plugin.
An organization-managed disablement is reported as blocked.
Local preference cannot override managed organization policy.
macOS setup requires Accessibility permission.
macOS setup requires Screen Recording permission separately.
Requests should identify the desired outcome.
Requests should identify the applications involved.
Requests should identify important constraints.
Active CLI permission mode determines application-control prompting.
The documented permission-status command lets the operator review the active mode.
When approval is requested, the Allow choice grants current-session application access.
When approval is requested, Always allow persists approval for future sessions.
The operator can decline or cancel an approval request.
Saved approval also applies to the app surface on the same computer.
At an approval prompt, confirm the requested application matches the intended request.
At an approval prompt, confirm the requested action matches the intended request.
Configured denial rules take precedence over the described saved approval.
Two Escape presses interrupt an active CLI operation; the cited span does not assert grant revocation.
The interactive off command disables computer use.
After disablement, status should be checked for both plugin and MCP server rather than assuming effective disablement.
When unavailable, check account feature eligibility.
When unavailable, check that the session is local.
When unavailable, check supported operating-system applicability.
When enabled but ineffective, check bundled plugin enablement separately.
When enabled but ineffective, check MCP-server connectivity separately.
For macOS troubleshooting, confirm the helper itself holds both required permissions; this repeated occurrence retains its helper-specific scope.
